name: robot
meaning: first Robot (class 101) in the level or NULL; when it answers msg 0x3681 the camera-box test uses it instead of the Wolf

name: cameraBox
meaning: IDCAMERABOX (prop +8); XZ-only test for the scripted lift camera

name: bottomY
meaning: lower end of travel (larger y, y points down)

name: topY
meaning: upper end of travel; one end is the start pos.y, the other -MAXZVALUE

name: cameraChangeY
meaning: -CAMERACHANGEZVALUE; the scripted camera runs only while pos.y < this

name: speed
meaning: STEP*30 units/s; per-frame step = speed*g_dt>>12 (truncated)

name: camera
meaning: CAMERA property resource (Scn_GetPropCamera); u16 at +0, s16 at +2/+4/+6 and the pointer +8 are passed to Camera_StartScripted

name: dirOn
meaning: direction taken on msg 0x1f (points from the start end toward the other end)

name: dirOff
meaning: direction taken on msg 0x20 (back toward the start end)

name: dir
meaning: current direction, +1 down or -1 up; initialised to dirOn

name: soundHandle
meaning: channel handle of motor sound 0x5e

name: frozen
meaning: Update does nothing while non-zero; only ever written 0 (PostLoadInit), so dead

name: switchedOn
meaning: WoodenLiftFlags bit0: switched on / camera armed (or/and byte ops at 0x50b132 0x50b151; read shr-free and al 1 at 0x50a7ab)

name: camReleased
meaning: WoodenLiftFlags bit1: scripted camera released (read shr al; and al 1 at 0x50a7e3; set or cl 2 at 0x50a8b3)

name: soundOn
meaning: WoodenLiftFlags bit2: motor sound playing (read shr dl 2; and dl 1 at 0x50a6f6; set or al 4 at 0x50a750)

name: rideBox
meaning: model box 0 + pos with min.y-5; objects overlapping it are carried

name: underBox
meaning: model box 0 + pos with max.y+50; bodyless objects inside block downward motion

name: downProbeResult
meaning: Collide_ResolveMove result of the 30-unit downward probe (0 = clear)

name: probeContact
meaning: contact info of the downward probe; floorObj with inst flag 8 is ignored

name: probeDelta
meaning: (0,30,0), the probe move vector
